registration-form.file_date: The file_date field holds the date when the document was filed or processed.
registration-form.foreign_principle_name: The foreign principle name refers to the name of the individual or entity that holds foreign ownership or control over the registrant.
registration-form.registrant_name: The registrant_name field holds the name of the entity or individual who registered or filed the document.
registration-form.registration_num: Registration number associated with the document.
registration-form.signer_name: The signer_name field holds the name of the person who signed the document.
registration-form.signer_title: The signer_title field holds the title or position of the person who signed the document.

ad-buy-form.advertiser: The field 'advertiser' holds the name or identifier of the company or entity that is responsible for the advertising campaign.
ad-buy-form.agency: The agency field holds information about the advertising agency responsible for the campaign.
ad-buy-form.contract_num: The contract number is a unique identifier for a specific advertising contract.
ad-buy-form.flight_from: The field 'flight_from' holds the starting location of a flight.
ad-buy-form.flight_to: The field 'flight_to' holds the destination or final location of a flight.
ad-buy-form.gross_amount: The gross_amount field holds the total amount of money associated with the document's advertising or marketing campaign.
ad-buy-form.product: The field 'product' holds information about the specific product or service being advertised in the document.
ad-buy-form.tv_address: TV address associated with the document.
ad-buy-form.channel: The channel field holds information about the specific media channel or platform where the advertisement is being aired.
ad-buy-form.program_desc: The field 'program_desc' holds a description of the program being advertised.
ad-buy-form.program_start_date: The program_start_date field holds the start date of a program in the document.
ad-buy-form.program_end_date: The program_end_date field holds the end date of the program associated with the document.
ad-buy-form.sub_amount: Sub-amount details for a specific transaction or service within the document.
